title: Cinematography Tool
description: Cinematography tool made for a university project.
mainText: This is a cinematography tool made for a university project. I have a huge passion in cinematograhy and rendering, I wanted to make a tool that I would personally use in the future for my own work. Therefore I made that tool with everything I would need and expect from a cinematography tool.

sections.caption: Camera panel spawns cameras and give controls, with quality of life buttons along with a camera preview to better show what the camera sees to give a better user experience
post processing panel is a quick access way to the post processing volume
The lighting panel comes with light presets, a list of lights, quality of life buttons  and a simple way to control add and alter lights
This gives a list of visual gobos with access to add gobos to the system, gobo spawning quality of life systems and quick gobo chaning.
These are real world values of lights
